name: skill-orchestrator
description: Align spoken requirements, orchestrate local Agent Skills, analyze screenplays, and direct one evidence-backed visual asset requirement.

interface.shortDescription: Align requirements and safely orchestrate local skills.
interface.longDescription: Turns a spoken need into a confirmed requirement contract, retrieves local Agent Skills, and runs a verified DAG. Its screenplay vertical builds a fresh whole-script baseline and directs exactly one character, location, scene state, or hero prop into a confirmed visual requirement without generating prompts or images.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $skill-orchestrator to align this request, retrieve the right skills, and propose a safe execution plan.
